## Problem

Describe the user-visible problem or contract being corrected.

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and the main implementation decisions.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Explain any relevant check that
could not be run.

## Compatibility

State language, manifest, standard-library, backend, package, editor, binary,
or platform compatibility effects. Write `None` when there are none.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated generated churn.
- [ ] C and Zig behavior remains aligned, or the difference is documented.
- [ ] Focused regression coverage was added or the reason it is unnecessary is stated.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and formal specifications were updated where needed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an `Unreleased` entry for observable behavior.
- [ ] Performance claims include reproducible before/after evidence.
- [ ] No private key, credential, personal data, or unpublished vulnerability is included.
